purpose: Plural Flow is fundamental local and cross-world participation within O-I#65/#220, not a second messaging or story system.
standing: Owner-commissioned specification and implementation plan, 29 September 2026; no runtime or human acceptance claimed.

plural65.policy: Retain full source and Wayfinder cases MP01-MP18. This adds obligations to existing WR/AG/WK/MC/SH/UI/GW/DO/PX/KN stories. Native operations, capability IDs and runtime bindings come from current owners; these planning labels do not mint them.

obligations.requirement: Flow retains complete rich writing while expressing actual participants, addressed contributions, branching and convergence with stable identities and compatibility.
required_branches: Distinct people/agents sharing a name or initial and one agent using successive sessions retain correct author and exact producing occurrence; native caller attribution differs from imported declaration.

Original F/H and v0.3 documents preserve document/entry identity and full entries/journal/notes/packet/media across read-only opening, explicit upgrade, export/reimport and incompatible-writer refusal.

Replies, passage selectors, side threads, multiple contributing parents and corrections retain exact source bases; readable chronological and focused views agree without copying conversations or inventing a runtime fork.

obligations.requirement: Native correlation carries each accepted Flow request through actual recipient context and provider output to the right returned contribution independently of the UI.
required_branches: Concurrent/crossed requests and unrelated assistant events retain entry/request/recipient/turn/output identity. Per-recipient group states preserve successful siblings; unsupported provider concurrency serializes instead of guessing.

Streaming updates one attributed live result; complete, interrupted, failed and uncertain results retain full output or exact source continuation. A first fragment/latest block is not a completed answer.
Close every Flow UI before a response. Native receipt, source inclusion and re-open recover the actual answer once, without another send, turn or React-owned pending state.

obligations.requirement: Independent native effects are recoverable and attributable through concurrent source edits, crashes and replay without losing writing or duplicating work.
required_branches: Interrupt at document commit, queue acceptance, dispatch/delivery, provider completion, inclusion and acknowledgement. Inspect existing journals to reconcile the same operation; changed payload under the same identity refuses.

Concurrent human/external edits and two independent replies preserve current bytes and rich collections. A late reply keeps its historical question basis; a stale source-edit proposal requires reconciliation.

Unknown external dispatch is reported rather than blindly retried; partial output and known effects survive. Reopening/relay/retry recovers an existing contribution rather than minting another authorial act.

obligations.native_locator: PLURAL-FLOW-SPEC sections 1, 2.1, 2.3 and 4.1; Wayfinder PF3, MP01/MP09/MP10/MP14/MP16
obligations.requirement: Humans and agents participate through real identity, bounded history, authority, SessionSpace and material relations, with readership distinct from addressing or invocation.
required_branches: Late join/observer/leave/revocation and body replacement alter actual delivered history and allowed effects. Each body receives its own eligible context; peer messages do not masquerade as its own assistant history or governing instructions.

Registered unembodied agents remain addressable. Durable identity/Position succession and exact generation/required-Workcell routes retain distinct outcomes, including same-named peers and stale leases.

Shared/exported content, embedded state, assets and derivatives respect real audience and caller authority. Private aside/notes use an appropriately scoped source rather than visual hiding; independent human worlds retain identity and attribution.

obligations.requirement: An admitted addressed, facilitated or bounded team exchange advances useful work without repeated human continuation and ends or waits for a meaningful reason.
required_branches: A direct requested response or selected standing arrangement wakes the eligible idle body through existing dispatch; reading, selection and presence alone do not invoke models. Busy sessions use their supported queue/interrupt path.

Facilitated and team exchanges use actual members and contributions, bounded purpose/participant/turn/time/tool policies and causal request identity. Self echoes, duplicate delivery and cross-face relay cannot reset reply budgets.

Resolved work, cancellation, reached budgets or a meaningful human question stops further unsent turns and leaves a usable continuation with actual completed effects. Message receipt alone does not count as useful response.

obligations.native_locator: PLURAL-FLOW-SPEC sections 1.2, 3.5 and 4.3; Wayfinder PF4, MP12-MP14/MP16
obligations.requirement: Local plural Flow, cross-Workcell participation and independently grounded SharedFields use the same conversational relations with explicit native source and hosted projection ownership.
required_branches: Complete one human/two-agent source-dependent inquiry locally with hosted SharedField/SpaceTimeDB and optional QL/Factory absent; ordinary writing and short contact remain independently useful.

Repeat across Mac/Omarchy with actual root/child NOW, sessions and material locations, then with two separately authorised human worlds. The same logical exchange maps to native Contribution and source refs; controlled accounts are not misreported as two-human evidence.

Source owner/CAS and hosted participation remain explicit. Offline drafts reconcile instead of claiming unsupported multi-writer merge; no raw shared HTML or context exposes private embedded journal/notes/assets. Preserve existing connector-group provenance and tests without claiming all external faces complete.

obligations.native_locator: PLURAL-FLOW-SPEC sections 4.5 and 5; Wayfinder PF2/PF4/PF5, MP15/MP18
obligations.requirement: The shared undertaking survives Day/session boundaries and returns useful, correctly attributed history to each person and later agent encounter.
required_branches: Personal Days, FieldDay and shared Flow/NOW stay distinct across timezones, rollover and offline late receipt; live work and pending contributions continue with actual occurrence/source relations.

Nara and historical intake preserve speaker, addressee, producer, source revision and correction: something said to the person does not become their authored belief. The same oracle journey/deck continues.

A fresh body uses a corrected retained source-backed result on a different example, with the relevant actual prepared/delivered context. A stored summary or Return envelope alone is not learning or useful continuation.

obligations.requirement: The existing Flow, standalone rich form and shared Expression experience make plural participation readable and operable through the same native actions.
required_branches: Real bring-in, address, reply, branch/rejoin, stop, source/deep-open, pending/recovery and close/reopen controls have native effects and readback. Inspecting a participant does not replace the person's own session.

Writing remains primary; names/roles/audience, changed source basis and pending outcomes are understandable without JSON. Preserve drafts, keyboard/narrow/reduced-motion use and complete rich media/presentation.

Flow, graph/constellation and activity Expression co-refer to actual source and contributions. Disconnect the producer and verify liveness changes; frozen/replay is read-only and does not repeat historical tool/model effects.

obligations.native_locator: PLURAL-FLOW-SPEC section 5; Wayfinder PF0/PF5 and section 4; TOOLS.md
obligations.requirement: The feature is developed and verified through existing capability/UX/practice and source-bound test relations with independent expected outcomes.
required_branches: Bind each selected branch to current repository-qualified capability, exact matrix digest/account, actual schema/effect, practice/loading, source/context and provider/authority/material basis through the existing compiler and binding path.

Required missing owner operations become implementation packets. New executable tests enter existing native suites/scenario bindings; preserved legacy stories/web65/CAW/QL meanings are not replaced by shorter test labels.

Ordinary actors receive meaningful tasks and discoverable powers; independent verifiers retain held-out source expectations and disconnected/wrong-target controls. Repair, replay, install and prove fresh-participant use, then return warranted source/practice changes.

matrix_binding_requirements.native_ids: Resolve actual current owner IDs and schemas; the planning module creates none.
